source.citation: S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024)
source.note: decay-mode table of the Higgs listing: signal-strength-constrained evaluations with SM theory input; tau tau error symmetrized (6.0 +0.8/-0.7)%

injection.note: divisor-nearest dictionary to the measured vector at N = 5040 (each c_i divides 5040; within every channel sigma)

protocol.P1_null_first: 3000 Dirichlet(k) draws, matched sigma pattern and total mass, common-N scan N in [2,5000]; threshold chi2_0.95(k)
protocol.P2_injection: table-specific truth (frozen in this file), Gaussian noise at the table sigma, 100 repetitions, recovery = rational identity of proportions
protocol.P3_decision: signature present iff min-chi2 < chi2_0.95(k) AND empirical p < 0.05 vs the P1 null
protocol.P4_regime: sigma_rel = 8-50%, two orders of magnitude above the calibrated sigma <= 0.3% regime: the channels are signal-strength-constrained evaluations with Standard Model theory input, not direct fraction measurements.  The null calibration carries the same weakness, so the false-positive rate is controlled but the power is minimal; the P2 injection quantifies the loss.  The seven measured channels sum to 0.881 of the width (gg, cc, and rare modes are unmeasured); the dictionary hypothesis constrains only the measured f_i = c_i/N with c_i | N, not the partition of the total.
